With 29 billion total parameters and just 4 billion activated parameters, the model provides enterprise-grade agentic capabilities at an extremely low compute threshold: it can be deployed in large-scale enterprise production environments or run locally on a personal consumer-grade graphics card, offering developers and enterprises a highly cost-effective AI agent solution.
